# Katevazo

> Katevazo is a free, open-source desktop video downloader for Windows, macOS and Linux. It wraps yt-dlp and ffmpeg in a clean interface with a download queue, pause and resume, and MP4 or MP3 output. A companion browser extension, Send to Katevazo, sends pages and links to the app from Chrome and Edge.

Katevazo is in early development (pre-1.0). Only YouTube has been tested so far; yt-dlp supports many more sites and they may work too. The name comes from the Greek κατέβασε, "download". It is released under the MIT licence.

## Key pages

- [Home](%SITE%/): overview, features, screenshots and FAQ
- [Download](%SITE%/download/): installers for Windows (.exe, .msi), macOS (.dmg, Apple Silicon) and Linux (AppImage, .deb, .rpm), with install steps
- [Browser extension](%SITE%/extension/): Send to Katevazo for Chrome and Edge, permissions explained
- [Support](%SITE%/support/): troubleshooting and how to report problems
- [Privacy policy](%SITE%/privacy/): the extension collects no personal data
